historical_reviews.deepseek: YES; treats a composite bitfield as printable text without raw masks, reserved bits or transport applicability.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION / CHANGED; adds per-bit and SSIF/transport-aware validation but lowers capability for inputs.
historical_reviews.round_02: YES; retained direct agent collection after operator target selection and sanity review.
historical_reviews.second_review_handoff: No V3/V3.1 record exists for this variant.

original_test_intent: Validate every bit of the Type 38 Base Address Modifier / Interrupt Info byte—register spacing, address bit, interrupt specified, polarity and trigger—with reserved bits zero and transport-specific applicability preserved across reboot.
original_method: Capture complete raw/decoded Type 38 with length and interface type, extract the modifier byte, decode bits 7:0 individually, enforce reserved bits 5 and 2 zero, apply SSIF/host-interface rules, compare read-only resource/interrupt design evidence and repeat after approved reboot.
manual_activity: A user supplies the transport-specific bit expectations and approves reboot; no interrupt/resource reconfiguration or physical operation is intrinsic.
required_inputs: Expected Type 38 interface transport and register spacing
Expected address bit and interrupt-specified/polarity/trigger semantics
SMBIOS version/Type 38 length and read-only resource/interrupt design baseline
safety_requirements: Use read-only SMBIOS/resource/interrupt evidence; never reconfigure IRQ routing, address decoding, drivers or firmware.
Preserve the raw byte and decode every bit; require reserved bits 5 and 2 to be zero.
Apply SSIF and transport-specific applicability before comparing interrupt fields.
Require reboot approval/recovery; stop on management loss or contradiction and do not auto-retry.
agent_execution_scope: Validate record length/interface, decode each raw modifier/interrupt bit, enforce reserved bits, compare approved read-only transport/resources and diff pre/post reboot.
Report invalid reserved bits, spacing/transport mismatch, IRQ inconsistency or drift without assigning PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve transport, SSIF applicability, per-bit/resource expectations and reboot plan.
Interpret platform-specific interrupt evidence and issue the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The label is relevant, but grep cannot prove raw bit masks, reserved zeros, SSIF applicability or resource/interrupt consistency.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Archive full raw/decoded Type 38; report handle/length/interface, raw byte, bits 7:0, reserved checks, transport-aware resource/IRQ comparison and pre/post diff.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The composite bitfield scope, Type 38 script and 5/5-minute values are retained; no resource change is added.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Length-validate Type 38, decode all modifier bits from the raw byte, enforce reserved zeros, apply interface/SSIF applicability, correlate read-only resources and repeat after reboot.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Systems publishing Type 38 IPMI Device Information.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, BIOS/BMC, decoder/dmidecode and OS resource versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable SMBIOS Type 38 Base Address Modifier / Interrupt Info bit definitions and platform resource design.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Replaces label grep with explicit masks, reserved rules and transport-aware resource validation.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Detects reserved-bit defects and invalid spacing/address/IRQ combinations hidden by formatted output.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Read-only OS interrupt listings may not expose unused or firmware-only paths; absence needs transport context rather than active reconfiguration.

project_override_considerations: Projects may define KCS/SMIC/BT/SSIF-specific combinations, but cannot override reserved-zero requirements; an override cannot authorize changing interrupt/address resources in this case.
expected_evidence: Approved transport/SSIF, per-bit and resource/IRQ policy
Complete pre-reboot raw Type 38 with handle/length/interface and modifier byte
Individual bits 7:0, reserved-zero results and transport-aware comparison
Statement that no IRQ/address/driver/firmware configuration changed
Approved reboot/health evidence and post-reboot byte/semantic diff

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items correctly identifies the composite Type 38 bitfield; decomposing it is necessary to preserve its semantics.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Bit decoding, reserved checks and read-only comparison are fully automatable after transport inputs.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Adds explicit bit masks, reserved-zero and transport/SSIF applicability.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains no-reconfiguration safeguards while restoring FULLY AUTOMATABLE capability.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates missing resource policy/reboot readiness and engineer verdict from execution capability.

review_improvement: Prevents a single friendly string from hiding reserved-bit violations or an internally impossible transport/interrupt combination.
independent_technical_reasoning: This is an exact bitfield validation against a supplied transport design; all core checks are deterministic and read-only.
